dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate symmetrical narrowing of the visible lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate grey with median pixel intensity values indicating a non-mature (sub-adult or juvenile) pigmentation phase.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, longitudinal linear streaks of lighter pixel intensity visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings on the posterior dorsal plane, consistent with healed rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly conspicuous, dark circular blowhole located at the anterior dorsal midline.
